entered into privately negotiated exchange agreements with certain holders of its outstanding 1.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027.
, Impinj will exchange approximately $56.5M in cash and 188,451 shares of common stock for $56.3M of the notes’ aggregate principal amount.

Following the exchanges, around $1M of the 2027 Notes will remain outstanding.
